text:
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: routing /v2 endpoints -> v2.3.1 across us-west starting 2025-09-21T15:00Z, canary 10% for 30m then 50% for 30m then full. jobs: canary, metrics, rollback-hook.

maya: heads-up — mobile SDK team asked for a hard pin option for some older app versions. they might need v1 fallback for another week.

liam: noted. can we limit canary to non-mobile clients first? mobile traffic is ~18% of us-west token volume.

deploy-bot: canary routing applied to: web-backend, server-side clients. mobile-tagged clients excluded by default.

maya: that's fine but SDK team wants an opt-in pin for enterprise customers too. how do we signal rollback if quality regresses?

chris: propose: phase=canary -> watch latency/errors/regen-quality -> if regen-quality delta > 6% or p95 latency +50ms trigger pause+rollback.

liam: add an automatic pin endpoint: POST /admin/pin-client {client_id, api_version:"v1", reason} — ops can call to pin. sasha, is that okay for SDK?

sasha: yes — SDK will respect server pin header X-Api-Version: v1. We'll ship a hotfix so pinned clients don't pollute v2 metrics. ETA: 2h.

oncall-ops: oncall is ready. Rollback playbook (short):
1) pause rollout via deploy-bot: /deploy pause 1857771234
2) pin affected client groups: curl -X POST "$DEPLOY_ADMIN/api/pin" -d '{"client_group":"mobile-1","api_version":"v1","reason":"regen-quality"}'
3) revert route config: /routes revert-to v1 on router group us-west
4) notify customers + statuspage template: "We reverted the v2 rollout for your client group; investigating"

maya: can we add a telemetry tag to canary requests so we can split quality evals by client platform?

liam: yes — add header X-Canary-Id: <canary-id>; metrics team will slice by platform.

deploy-bot: canary deployed (10%). watch keys: model.quality.delta, client.err.rate, throughput, p95_latency. Alert thresholds are set.

chris: I've uploaded a short regression test set to s3://redwood-evals/v2_canary/ — running evals every 5m.

maya: I'll notify SDK leads and legal for enterprise pin sign-off. please don't lift mobile exclusion until SDK hotfix is out.

sasha: hotfix deployed to staging; rolling to prod in 20m. once live, we'll accept pins.

deploy-bot: canary reached 50% at 15:28Z. metrics stable so far.

liam: thumbs up. if anything spikes, we follow rollback playbook. thanks all. :thumbsup:
